rationale: The assistant correctly ruled out the heater once the customer said the drum got hot and the clothes came out hot and damp. It identified overloading (9kg against 6kg dry capacity) and then, after the half-load test, the reduced spin as the cause, and it recommended no parts. The first reply was long and listed many generic checks, and the pump filter advice was repeated, but these were minor issues. The filter steps did include safe isolation advice.
